_tuning_notes: Phase 2 economy. money_per_emerald: internal money units one emerald is worth — citizen wealth and every player-facing price convert at this rate. citizen_purse_cap / trader_emerald_float: how many emeralds a citizen actually carries as items (the rest of their wealth stays abstract holdings, so citizens are not an emerald farm). trade_lot: units of a good exchanged per player trade. newborn_stake: money a newborn is given so it starts above the liquidity floor — drawn from the treasury and levied from the richest, never minted. growth_food_per_citizen: food the city must hold PER CITIZEN before it will have another. growth_interval_ticks: how often a birth is considered.
